reviewNotes: Completed 36 original low-typing adjective questions. Editorial pass covered every German sentence, all offered distractors, answer keys, bilingual hints/explanations, and distinct situations. Deferred elementary bereit (B1 level unresolved) and malformed citation lemma besonder. Clarified outer versus inner (äußerlich), fixed-term versus generic temporary (befristet), organic food versus scientific biology, justified criticism (berechtigt), and attributive bisherig. Existing objectives and earlier batches checked for semantic overlaps. Structural checks are not CEFR certification, human review, rights clearance or measured transfer; publication remains prohibited.
